reviews.text: Maddie is knowledgeable and patient.  She understood immediately what the issues are and how to work on changing Layla's behavior.  Layla  happily accepted her attentions as a caring friend.  I know the end results will be successful so we can start therapy training.

Our Standard Schnauzer has some challenges navigating the human world and we've been working with Maddie to make it more easier for him and us.

It was amazing to see our Shane respond to Maddie's training / suggestion in real time during our sessions.

By following Maddie's advise and tips, we are seeing positive changes in how our pup sees the world. Couldn't have been happier.

We had a great experience working with Anna on obedience and fun trick training for my dog. She is patient, knowledgeable and made every session enjoyable for both of us. We learned so much along the way and I highly recommend her to anyone looking for an excellent dog trainer!

Paws for Thought has truly been a lifesaver-- we cannot thank Maddie enough for the work she has put into getting to know our dog & helping us navigate these final stages of puppyhood. ♡

When we started working together, we were at a very sensitive crossroads with reactivity & final stages of heat before a spay. Maddie did a wonderful job of helping us understand our dog on a deeper level and reframing our thinking to see behaviors as communication. This has truly made all the difference in helping our dog feel comfortable enough to even be available for learning/reinforcement of any kind.

Prior to beginning our work together, we had tried searching everywhere for advice, education, and strategies, but never felt like it aligned with our dog specifically. She wasn't particularly food motivated, and was often already overwhelmed before we could reinforce.

Before we started, we had zero commands; after three sessions, we've learned "sit", "stay", "place", "thank you", "find it", *and* we now have extremely practical strategies and cues to apply across contexts in reducing reactivity in a graduated way.

Maddie also provides highly detailed notes that summarize practice activities, general concepts to remain aware of throughout the week, and feedback on what is working, what needs adjustment, and guidance for the future. This feedback alone was truly invaluable, as we are first-time pup parents and didn't know what we didn't know.

She is incredibly knowledgable, and she does a fantastic job with explaining concepts in a way that is easily digestible & applicable to different contexts.

Since we've began working together, we've already noticed a tremendous difference in our chi's responsiveness to us, reduced reactivity, increased confidence, and a general back-and-forth that we couldn't really break through to before we started.

I can't recommend this service enough to anyone with a tiny dog and an anxious/fearful temperament in NYC. We realized that we had to change our approach to exposure and training to avoid reinforcing discomfort/fear around being in new spaces with new people.

It is truly well-worth the money for the education we've gotten, the progress we've made in such a short time, and the understanding we now have of not only the "Why" behind the behaviors, but how to navigate situations in the moment & work towards these skills in a scaffolded/graduated way.

Thank you Maddie and PawsForThought!! We truly could not have done it without you.

Thank you for all that you do! ♡ ◡̈

My wife and I have been working with Maddie for two years. She has given us tools to manage the chaos of puppyhood and life with a very sensitive dog which has transformed our lives. We cannot thank Maddie enough for all the guidance and training.

Maddie a was great and very helpful in working with our nervous, anxious dog, Bruno. We are grateful for the assistance, tools and training she provided to help Bruno overcome some of his nervousness. Strong recommend!

I adopted a 2 month old mixed breed pup in February, I was super nervous to train him on my own and I am so happy I discovered Paws for Thought.

Working with Maddie has been very beneficial, she is extremely patient, kind and works with you to problem solve right on the spot. She has great advice and was an overall pleasure to work with.

I will take the skills I learned with her and continue to train my pup as he grows.

Maddie and Erin are absolute all stars!! I adopted my sweet crazy Poppy (5 yr old female corgi) from a rescue last August. Her personality began to fully emerge ~2-3 months post adoption, resulting in severe separation anxiety (this was obvious right away) plus leash reactivity (took longer to appear). She has VERY big emotions and after me working with a more generalized trainer for a few months in addition to doing a lot of my own research (lots of conflicting information out there)... my vet finally recommended a vet behaviorist, who then recommended Paws for Thoughts. I began working with Maddie, on leash reactivity and noise sensitivity, and Erin, on separation anxiety, late last fall (Nov / early Dec 2026) and have already seen tremendous progress on both fronts!

I've had many moments of complete despair and Maddie and Erin have truly pulled me through, sometimes serving as MY therapist ha (as it's important I learn to regulate my emotions while on this journey as well). They've provided so many helpful tips with clear instruction and guidance on how to continue executing and perfecting on my own. I am SO happy that I have been able to resume a bit of freedom outside of my apartment (from 10 sec departures in late Nov '26 to 50 minute departures now in Apr '27, outside of unavoidable departures with extra meds + sitter). Additionally, I've gained much more confidence and resilience when on walks with Poppy due to her ability to now fairly consistently disengage without being prompted and much faster recovery if/when she does react.

It's been a long journey and the work is far from done, but I'm incredibly happy with the results to-date and am motivated to continue -- all because of Maddie and Erin's personalized curriculum, attentiveness, communicativeness, and just overall fun and friendly demeanor :) They make what is otherwise an incredibly stressful and life-altering situation into a *dare I say it* enjoyable one!

Anna with Paws for Thought is truly amazing.  We first were introduced when I got my Bernedoodle puppy, Cornelius, in the summer of 2024.  Cornelius was 5 months old when he joined me in the city and he presented with some pretty serious urban anxiety.  He naturally is a very sensitive and shy boy so the lively, crowded, and loud East Village / Union Square neighborhood that I live in turned into a nightmare for my little bud (and for me because I struggled to do basic things with him like walks as he would pancake in fear).

Anna really helped to guide me in how to help manage the urban anxiety and then worked on training tactics for confidence building and enrichment.  I’ve been working with Anna for nearly two years now and she’s been such a critical resource around Cornelius’ development from basic manners, to how to handle his humping era (in the months before his neuter), to locking down important skills like recall etc.  She’s also recommended great group classes to help work on my dog’s reactivity, whether they are lead by herself or by Erin (another wonderful trainer!).  Both Anna and Erin use positive reinforcement and are wonderful in terms of their ability to work with all different types of dogs, even sensitive, nervous, and reactive pups like my little bud.  I couldn’t recommend them both enough!
